title: Evaluation of MLLM-Agnostic Plug-and-Play Keyframe Selection Methods for Long Video Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2609.13250v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) cannot process every frame of a long video because of limitations in visual-token and computational budgets. Three primary approaches have been proposed to enhance their long-video understanding capabilities: (i) Retraining an MLLM on a large video corpus and/or extending its input length; (ii) Training an adapter for a specific MLLM that takes the entire video and the query as input and selects the most relevant video frames; and (iii) Developing a training-free, plug-and-play (PaP) adapter that is MLLM-agnostic. We refer to the third approach as PaP keyframe selection. A PaP method may use only candidate video frames without considering the query, or it may use both candidate video frames and the query. translated_title: 面向长视频理解的与多模态大语言模型无关的即插即用关键帧选择方法评估
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）由于视觉token和计算预算的限制，无法处理长视频的每一帧。为了增强其长视频理解能力，已有三种主要方法被提出：(i) 在大规模视频语料库上重新训练MLLM和/或扩展其输入长度；(ii) 为特定MLLM训练一个适配器，该适配器以整个视频和查询作为输入，并选择最相关的视频帧；(iii) 开发一种无需训练的、即插即用（PaP）的、与具体MLLM无关的适配器。我们将第三种方法称为PaP关键帧选择。PaP方法可以仅使用候选视频帧而不考虑查询，也可以同时使用候选视频帧和查询。第一种方法的成本极其高昂。第二种方法需要大量的训练时间和计算资源，但由于适配器包含……（原文截断）
tldr: 本文系统评估了无需训练、与具体MLLM无关的即插即用关键帧选择方法在长视频理解中的有效性，为应对多模态大语言模型处理长视频时的计算瓶颈提供了参考。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates training-free, MLLM-agnostic plug-and-play keyframe selection methods for long video understanding, providing insights into addressing the visual-token and computational budget limitations of MLLMs.
